dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Time flows differently here, just like in the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: So you'll just have to trust what your own body is telling you.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Take a break whenever you get tired, and don't head out again until you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Challenging the powerful is always a painful process. You may fail many times before you succeed, and sustain devastating wounds along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: But when you look back on it, you'll see that it was worthwhile.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: After all, for the one who finds no worthy opponent left in the world, only loneliness awaits.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Humans have always sought different ways to record the past. Perhaps this very place is a product of someone's attempt to preserve a piece of their history.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: But the truth is, history is dead and gone. It cannot speak for itself, or tell its own story. Disaster and conflict, regret and suffering — by the time future generations look back on it, all that remains will be a fractured skeleton of what once was.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: So, do your best to remember the scenery along the way. Even if it seems mundane, it bears the footprints of countless lives.
